headline: No one is surprised that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown.
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses AI doomsday predictions. He claims a "0% chance" of AI causing humanity's end. This contradicts many AI researchers' long-standing concerns.

headline: Kojima Productions disputes reports the studio is in trouble
summary: Kojima Productions denies rumors of financial trouble after Sony dropped Hideo Kojima's 'Physint'. The next Kojima title will now be an Xbox exclusive. Reports cited missed deadlines and budget concerns for the Sony split.

headline: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
summary: Donald Trump announced plans for an "AI czar" to lead a new "AI force" via Truth Social. He stated his administration would not hinder AI development. This comes amidst calls for caution on AI from various sectors.

headline: A24’s reputation is on the line with the SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 is developing a V/H/S horror anthology film set in the SCP Foundation universe. The announcement immediately sparked significant fan backlash. This project follows A24's success with the internet horror adaptation 'Backrooms'.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Defies Expectations With $108 Million Box Office Opening Weekend
summary: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' earned an impressive $108.3 million globally on its opening weekend. The film succeeded despite initial fan backlash. Its box office performance defied expectations.

headline: Disney+ to Allow Ads on All Plans Following Changes Detailed in Updated Subscriber Agreement
summary: Disney+ has updated its subscriber agreement to permit ads on all subscription plans. This change will affect all tiers of service. Subscribers should review the revised terms.

headline: Poppy Playtime Spinoff Escape from Playtime Gets Early Access Release Date
summary: 'Escape from Playtime', a co-op survival horror spinoff, announced its Early Access release date. The game will launch on Steam Early Access October 21. It's based on the popular 'Poppy's Playtime' episodic horror series.

headline: Zach Cregger Suggests There's No 'Cregger Cut' of Resident Evil as Fans Hope to See Trimmed Jokes
summary: Director Zach Cregger indicates no "Cregger cut" of 'Resident Evil' is planned. Fans hoped for a version including trimmed jokes. The director's statement clarifies future release expectations.

headline: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
summary: German Chancellor Merz described recent state election results as a "disaster" for his CDU party. Exit polls show significant losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Despite the setbacks, Merz has pledged to remain in his position.

headline: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
summary: Earl Spencer spoke to the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg ahead of his new book's release. He defended claims made about the King. The interview covers aspects of his relationship with his sister, Diana.

headline: Watch: Emotional Earl Spencer says he misses sister Diana every day
summary: An emotional Earl Spencer stated he misses his sister Diana daily during a BBC interview. He described his upcoming book as his "final word" and a "celebration of her." The interview was conducted by Laura Kuenssberg.

headline: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
summary: Moscow's mayor reported 450 drones were downed during a large overnight attack. Two people reportedly died in the barrage. This represents the largest drone attack on Moscow.
